en.title: Calculate Min Cost (Password Removal)
en.description: You are given password, reference, and the deletion costs of the 26 lowercase letters. Delete every character in password that appears in the character set of reference; each deleted character is charged its letter's cost. Find the minimum total cost.
en.input: The first line is password, the second line is reference, and the third line gives cost[0..25] in order. Both strings consist of lowercase English letters and have length 1..100000; each cost is 1..100. This site carries the original function parameters in a three-line stdin/stdout format.
en.output: Output the minimum cost of deleting all characters in password that match reference.
en.explanation: reference only determines the set of characters to delete; every matching position in password is charged separately. See the accompanying solution for the full derivation.
hints: First convert reference into a character set, then scan password; each matching character is charged once.
